assignment.change_rule: Existing IDs cannot move between splits inside dataset version 1.2.0. Any source-row change requires an explicit new dataset version and registry review.

challenge_policy.purpose: Behavioral evaluation of ambiguity, safety overrides and unsupported modality.

duplicate_detection.normalization: Unicode NFKD, casefold, remove diacritics, replace non-alphanumeric runs with one space.

near_duplicates.blocking_rule: Block when both thresholds are met, or when either metric is at least 0.96.

release_requirements: Every intent and risk label appears in train, validation and test.
Every regular label has exactly six train, one validation and one test row.
Challenge rows remain isolated from regular splits.
IDs and normalized texts are globally unique.
No blocking near-duplicate crosses split boundaries.
All rows use the frozen dataset version.
Generated file hashes and source fingerprints match the manifest.
The deterministic rebuild produces the same manifest and audit report.
